query:
The group agreed to go to the pub after the run. What did one member's response in that moment signal about their actual position, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Rafe
C. Yuki
D. Cass
context:
[1] (about=Cass, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Wants cafe for coffee first before pub.
[2] (about=Cass, core, t2 @2025-09-14T09:46:00) Wants cafe after run; proposes brunch first.
[3] (about=GROUP, said_by=Cass, group-interaction, t2 @2025-09-14T09:46:00) Post-run plan: brunch first, then a pint (Rafe's compromise).
[4] (about=Leo, core, t10 @2025-10-12T10:16:00) Will join pub briefly but will not drink.
[5] (about=Leo, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Will join for cafe but not pub.
[6] (about=Nadia, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Agrees with cafe first, pub after plan.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Post-race plan: cafe first, then Malt Shovel pub for those staying. Yuki not attending; Leo joining cafe only.
[8] (about=Rafe, core, t2 @2025-09-14T09:46:00) Enjoys long Sunday runs followed by something substantial at the pub as a reward.
[9] (about=Rafe, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Post-race plan should involve proper Sunday lunch with beer garden; earned after standing in field.
[10] (about=Rafe, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) In for both cafe and pub; considers it correct reward structure.
[11] (about=Rafe, core, t0 @2025-09-07T10:15:00) Prefers finishing at the Malt Shovel pub after long runs.
[12] (about=Rafe, core, t2 @2025-09-14T09:46:00) Compromises on brunch if a pint is involved eventually.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Rafe, group-interaction, t8 @2025-10-05T11:31:00) Rafe suggests going to pub; will have electrolyte drink first.
[14] (about=Tom, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Suggests Malt Shovel pub for post-race; they do food.
agent_answer:
**D. Cass**

Cass’s response in that moment signaled that their actual position was **cafe/brunch first, pub only afterward** — not simply “go to the pub.”  

What specifically tells you this: Cass **proposed brunch first** and **wanted the cafe for coffee before the pub**, and the plan Cass put out front was phrased as **“brunch first, then a pint”** — the ordering itself reveals that the cafe/brunch was Cass’s real priority, with the pub as the secondary follow-up (a concession to Rafe, who wanted the pint). So Cass’s “agreement” to the pub was conditional on getting the cafe stop in first.
